text:
```yaml
name: Publish Crates
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      crate:
        description: 'Crate to publish (ic-asset or icx-asset)'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - ic-asset
          - icx-asset

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          cache: true
          cache-workspaces: |
            crates/ic-asset/Cargo.toml
            crates/icx-asset/Cargo.toml

      - name: Configure Cargo registry
        run: |
          echo "[registry]" >> ~/.cargo/config.toml
          echo "token = \"${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}\"" >> ~/.cargo/config.toml

      - name: Publish crate
        run: |
          case "${{ github.event.inputs.crate }}" in
            "ic-asset")
              cargo publish -p ic-asset --token "${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}"
              ;;
            "icx-asset")
              cargo publish -p icx-asset --token "${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}"
              ;;
          esac
```
